column2: Section  60  of  the  principal  enactment  is  hereby

column1: repealed and the following section is substituted therefor:-

column2: 60.  Any  person  who,  for  the  purpose  of
procuring the solemnization or registration of
a  Kandyan  marriage  knowingly  or  wilfully
makes and subscribes any false declaration or
signs any false notice, under this Act shall be
guilty of an offence under this Act.”.
